definition: Alexander Gammerman (born 2 November 1944) is a British computer scientist, and professor at Royal Holloway University of London.
details: He is the co-inventor of conformal prediction. He is the founding director of the Centre for Machine Learning at Royal Holloway, University of London, and a Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Alexander Gammerman — a small key that opens a big door.
